correctness.rationale: A fixed point must be (sin z,sin z,z) with z=k sin z, and every such point is fixed. For k>0 positive roots are confined to the sine-positive lobes and bounded by k. The derivative of z/sin z has numerator sin z−z cos z whose derivative is z sin z. This proves strictly increasing behavior from 1 on the first lobe and exactly one minimum on every later lobe. Thus a later-lobe threshold counts one positive double-root location, not two distinct equilibria there; doubling the positive census accounts for signs and adding one accounts for the origin. K_m=2mπ+O(1) gives the claimed growth. On the pure-feedback line the eigenvalues are 0,0,k cos z. On the nonzero branches w=z cot z strictly decreases because z−sin z cos z=2∫_0^z sin²t dt>0; a later lobe's smaller root has w>1, whereas the increasing-gain branch traverses w=+1 to −1 at the stated thresholds. At K_0 the +1 multiplier is at the origin, not a nonzero fold. The exact interval ordering follows from the ordering of the critical locations. Expanding cot about 0 gives A_m−ζ_m and η_m−A_m both equal to A_m^−1+O(A_m^−3); the common 1/(2A_m) term in the square-root expansions cancels in the width. Finally I−DF is invertible at each strict sink, so openness of the multiplier condition and implicit continuation establish the two symmetry-related sinks in three parameters. Neutral endpoints are excluded by the stipulated definition of attraction. The Finding's 'unique positive root already present' refers to the first lobe; higher lobes contribute exactly as in the census.
residual_risks: Bisection is numerical corroboration only. Strict linear sinks are classified, not nonlinear behavior of neutral endpoints, stability everywhere off the pure-feedback line or any positive-period orbit.

value.rationale: The natural pure-feedback member isolates the effect of the gain in a published 3D family. The result pinpoints all locations where nonzero fixed-point attraction is possible on that line, proves infinitely many such disjoint but vanishing-width intervals, and quantifies the width. It also identifies equilibria missed by any discussion restricted to the origin. The continuation ensures the sinks are not confined to an exactly triangular Jacobian. Together these features have more use than the standard local fold or flip test alone.
residual_risks: No full off-line phase diagram, nonlinear endpoint analysis or claim about basins or other attractors.
